product_one_liner.value: Jack & Jill provides AI agents that help job seekers discover suitable roles and prepare for interviews, while helping employers find candidates and make direct, mutually matched introductions.

employee_band.notes: The company states that there are 28 people on its team; this direct statement takes precedence over inconsistent directory counts.

founded_year.notes: Company and founder profiles identify 2025 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains hiring, product and marketing content and only one product-build article; it does not meet the two engineer-authored technical-post requirement.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation covers onboarding, hiring briefs, candidate search, permissions, pipeline management and multiple integrations.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live internal openings include Founding Engineer and GTM Engineer, but none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Secondary evidence: a review of the company’s Platform Terms, captured on 2026-09-25, explicitly identifies these providers. The currently readable candidate Terms and Privacy Policy do not independently name them.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed legal pages claim none of the listed certifications. The Privacy Policy discusses UK GDPR rights and legal obligations, not a GDPR certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The 2026-09-15 Series A falls within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Account Executive openings in London and San Francisco.

launched_6mo.notes: Company Insights launched in Jill on 2026-11-04, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small public team roster and leadership profiles were checked. The CEO and CTO both started in April 2025, before the window; no in-window C-level or VP appointment or departure was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The company’s own AE and GTM Engineer postings describe CRM and GTM infrastructure but name no CRM or sales/marketing platform. Customer job listings and recommended tools were not treated as internal usage.
